emergency.name: Emergency Department
emergency.description: Life-threatening problems: chest pain, stroke signs, severe breathing trouble, major injury, collapse.

cardiology.name: Cardiology
cardiology.description: Heart problems: palpitations, blood pressure, known heart disease follow-up.

neurology.name: Neurology
neurology.description: Headaches, migraine, seizures, numbness, dizziness, stroke follow-up.

gastroenterology.name: Gastroenterology
gastroenterology.description: Stomach pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, acidity, liver problems.

orthopedics.name: Orthopaedics
orthopedics.description: Bones, joints, sprains, fractures, back pain.

dermatology.name: Dermatology
dermatology.description: Skin rashes, itching, allergies of the skin, acne, infections of the skin.

ent.name: ENT (Ear, Nose and Throat)
ent.description: Sore throat, ear pain, sinus problems, hearing problems.

general-medicine.name: General Medicine (OPD)
general-medicine.description: Fever, infections, diabetes, general check-ups and anything not listed elsewhere.

pediatrics.name: Paediatrics
pediatrics.description: Children under 16: fever, cough, rashes, feeding problems, vaccination.

mental-health.name: Mental Health & Counselling
mental-health.description: Low mood, anxiety, stress, sleep problems, thoughts of self-harm.
